metric_definitions.exact_action_match: Action type and expected tool must match; full arguments must also match for examples with expected arguments. Non-tool actions have no argument comparison.
metric_definitions.tool_selection_rate: Correct tool among examples with an expected tool; non-tool examples excluded.
metric_definitions.argument_exact_rate: Exact argument dictionary among examples with expected arguments; non-tool examples excluded.
metric_definitions.latency: Wall-clock time around one model-only action call, including local Ollama HTTP and parsing; no business tool execution.

provenance: Measured normalized Ollama proposal. This evaluator does not invoke the hybrid controller or execute business tools. Existing historical benchmark artifacts were not modified.
